look_here_first: Yellow-flowered bladderpod whose upper leaves are notably sessile, helping separate it from more obviously petiolate relatives.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: upper leaves sessile or nearly so

lookalikes.differences: The leaf attachment is the first-look cue: sessilis = sessile. Use that before diving into fruit details.

source_credit: Existing Hays Botany species record and scientific source notes; original full record retained in assigned family staging branch
